findings.message: VERIFIED RESOLVED (run-007 hennessy2022-support, repaired in 44bc1d7). specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-05.md line 41 now states "Level of support: abstract only", names the three claims topic-03 draws (limited and often not evidence-informed development provision, real potential to extend formal programmes and informal peer learning, mixed outcomes), records the abstract read on 2026-09-15, and says nothing beyond the abstract is claimed; this reconciles with content-spec.md reading-list row "Abstract read 2026-09-15". topic-03.mdx "### Pressure to integrate technology" states the review's scope limit (technology for developing teachers, not pupils' classroom use) at the point of use and draws exactly the three declared claims, so the prose states no more than the declaration supports. The repair took the declaration route rather than adding a prose uncorroborated marker; judged against the G3 reference the declaration is honest and complete, which is the test D-2026-0001 sets.

VERIFIED RESOLVED (run-007 rrq9-blueprint-floor, repaired in 44bc1d7). unit-assessment.mdx RRQ 9 now reads "Name the three regions into which a teacher's situation divides, with two examples in each, and explain why most challenges cannot be placed wholly in one region" and is tagged (Understand); its mark scheme is 7 marks (3 for the region names, 2 for apt examples, 2 for the cross-region explanation with illustration). The added clause requires the comprehension topic-04 teaches directly ("Most challenges have a part in each region. Class size is outside; what happens in the first ten minutes with a class that size is inside"), so the classification is honest and the blueprint floor "RRQs (10): Understand to Analyze" (content-spec.md Unit 5 assessment blueprint) is met: the ten RRQs are now six Understand, one Apply, three Analyze, none below Understand.

REFUTATION VERIFIED (run-007 erq-rubric-360-unreachable). Re-measured per references/g3.md on a fresh two-locale build served at localhost:3000: at 360x780 each of the five ERQ rubric <table> elements on unit-assessment is its own scroll container (clientWidth 328, scrollWidth 473-542) carrying tabindex="0", role="region" and aria-label "Scrollable table, scroll sideways to see all columns"; setting table.scrollLeft = table.scrollWidth brings the "Strong (4-5)" column from x 356-558 (off-screen) to x 211-344, fully inside the viewport, in all five tables. Run-007 measured the wrapping div.theme-doc-markdown, whose overflow-x: visible and scrollWidth === clientWidth are expected. The four topic mini-rubric tables fit entirely (client 328 = scroll 328). Evidence: logs-feat023-r1/figure-text-overlap.log (ERQ rubric re-measure section), logs-feat023-r1/render-review.log section B.

RESOLVED (run-007 handoff-process finding). The feat023-r1 manifest was verified rather than refreshed: recomputing the bundle with the contract's own inputManifest() gives 107 paths matching 107, zero digest mismatches, zero paths added or dropped, and a skill_digest (eccc4074...) equal to skillDigest(root, "G3"); every bound input is clean at HEAD bb21d67, which is the author_run_id. The bundle is truthful and reproducible from the committed state, which is what the run-007 finding required.

RESOLVED (run-007 cycle-budget finding). EFMP-302 G3 cycles 001-007 belonged to the earlier submission and exhausted its two-cycle budget. Feature 023 (specs/023-author-efmp-302/spec.md, orchestrator mandate 2026-09-24) is a new submission whose scope is completing EFMP-302 with fresh advisory G3 reviews "within the two-cycle budget per ADR-0019"; this run is cycle 1 of that submission, and the prior record's findings are carried into it rather than re-litigated.

RESOLVED (carried from run 002 via run 007; rrq9 weighting). RRQ 9 no longer inverts cognitive demand: it fell from 9 wholly-recall marks to 7 marks of which 4 reward apt examples and the cross-region explanation, and it is no longer recall-bound. The remaining RRQ distribution (Analyze items at 5/5/4, Apply at 6, Understand at 4/6/4/5/7) is a defensible design choice with the higher-order weight carried by the five 20-mark ERQs.

Carried from run 002 and run 007, still live. unit-assessment.mdx frontmatter blooms_summary declares "MCQs at Remember and Understand with two at Apply; RRQs at Understand and Analyze", but the bank carries FOUR Apply-tagged MCQs (items 3, 4, 8, 9) and one Apply-tagged RRQ (item 5). The bank itself is within the style-guide ranges (MCQs "Remember -> Apply", RRQs "Understand -> Analyze"); only the summary sentence is wrong. Repair: restate blooms_summary to match the bank.

Carried from run 002 and run 007, still live. specs/content/efmp-302/figures/unit-05.md line 6 reads "the unit carries three `flowchart`s (`fig-U5-2`, `fig-U5-8`)" while naming two IDs, and the manifest table has exactly two flowchart rows. Repair: change "three" to "two".

Carried from run 002 and run 007, still live. specs/content/efmp-302/content-spec.md Unit 5 "### Topic list" glosses the confirmed seam as "the first three bullets describe conditions a teacher is placed in, the last three describe demands other parties make of them", but the guide bullet order is workload/stress/burnout; multilingual and multi-grade; increased accountability; lack of support and resources; stakeholder expectations; status and recognition, and the authoritative sub-topic table assigns bullets 1, 2 and 4 to topic 5.1 and bullets 3, 5 and 6 to topic 5.2. The partition is sound, owner-confirmed (2026-09-18) and disclosed to the learner; only the gloss misdescribes it. Repair: describe the partition as conditions (bullets 1, 2, 4) against external demands (bullets 3, 5, 6).

Carried from run 002 and run 007, still live. specs/content/efmp-302/concepts/unit-05.md states that only "Stress" and "Multi-grade Classroom" draw on the terminology bank and the remaining fourteen Urdu labels are authored, but specs/content/terminology.csv line 118 already banks "Teacher Burnout,پیشہ ورانہ تھکن,EFMP-302 Unit 5", the identical Urdu form the concept graph uses for CON:EFMP-302-5-4. At least one of the fourteen is already banked, so the note misdirects the G5 reviewer about how much is unbanked. Repair: count Burnout as banked (thirteen authored) or promote the note.

Carried from run 002 and run 007, still live; counted in this run's rendered DOM (render-review.log section A). Further-reading links whose accessible text is a bare URL: topic-01 four, topic-02 three, topic-03 one, topic-04 two, ten in all. Conventional in a bibliography but not descriptive link text. Repair: link the article title and keep the DOI visible as text.

Carried from run 002 and run 007, still live. static/img/figures/efmp-302/unit-05/fig-U5-7.svg carries the footer "The regions are not fixed. A teacher who builds standing over a term moves items from the third region into the second." No prose in topic-04.mdx states this and it sits in mild tension with the same topic's "no amount of individual effort moves them" (which is about the third region's structural items). The claim is defensible but a figure should not be the only place a substantive claim is made. Repair: state it in topic-04 prose or drop it from the figure.

Carried from run 001 through run 007, still live. docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-05/unit-teacher-notes.mdx line 78 reads "Unit 1's professional associations and Topic 5.4's second region, what you can influence, are where collective pressure belongs", while topic-04.mdx places class size, pay scales and the examination system in the THIRD region and aims collective pressure at exactly those third-region matters. The coherent reading (organising is how a third-region matter becomes influenceable) exists but is stated nowhere in prose. Confined to a teacher-facing ancillary file; no learner-facing item depends on it. Repair: reword to direct collective action at third-region matters through associations, per topic-04's own caution paragraph.

Carried from run 007, still live. specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-05.md line 23 correctly states "Six of twelve sub-topics carry no-external-source", but the no-external-source row at line 53 enumerates only five (U5-01, U5-03, U5-04, U5-10, U5-11), omitting U5-07 which coverage/unit-05.md grounds as no-external-source. Repair: add topic-02.mdx U5-07 to the row's description and Supports column.

Carried from run 007, still live. specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-05.md line 50 claims isore2009 supports "topic-02.mdx U5-07 (the activity on four demands in one week)", matching the reinforcement row in coverage/unit-05.md. The bound excerpt is an OECD review of teacher evaluation systems; its Annex 1 stakeholder list and conclusion overlap three of the activity's four parties, but the activity is about conflicting demands on a teacher's working week, which the excerpt does not address, and the activity carries no Isore citation in prose. A reinforcement row coverage itself marks "not required for the gate". Repair: drop the reinforcement mapping or narrow its gloss to the stakeholder enumeration.

Carried from run 007, still live. topic-01.mdx "### Stress and burnout, and how the two differ" states the demands Skaalvik and Skaalvik measured were "time pressure, low student motivation and a dissonant value context". The bound excerpt sources/texts/skaalvik2020.md names only time pressure and dissonant value context; "low student motivation" appears in content-spec.md's reading-list row as recorded from the 2026-09-15 abstract read, so the claim is not unsupported but is not corroborated by anything bound into this review. Repair: extend the bound excerpt to cover the third demand or attribute the three-demand list to the abstract read.

Carried from run 007, still live. unit-assessment.mdx RRQ 2 asks the candidate to "state where each of this unit's two burnout sources was conducted". Only Skaalvik and Skaalvik has a conduct location (262 Norwegian high-school teachers); Maslach and Leiter is a review across human-service occupations with no site, and topic-01 says expressly that the paper "is not about teachers". The mark scheme resolves it sensibly by asking for a population rather than a place, so the item is answerable and the key is right; the stem's presupposition is loose. Repair: reword to "state the scope of each of this unit's two burnout sources".

Carried from run 007, still live. specs/content/efmp-302/sources/texts/hargreaves2000.md closes with "This corroborates the EFMP-302 Unit 5 G3 blocking finding: coverage/unit-05.md grounds U5-07 and U5-08 in this key", which was true when written: coverage now grounds hargreaves2000 in U5-06 only and the finding it cites is closed. A bound evidence file carrying a stale statement about a live review process can mislead a later reviewer. Repair: update or date-stamp the note.

New this run. SLO:EFMP-302-5-2 is referenced in the clo_refs of index.mdx, topic-03.mdx, topic-04.mdx, unit-assessment.mdx and unit-teacher-notes.mdx, and in concepts/unit-05.md's SLO refs column for every topic-5.3/5.4 concept, but it is defined nowhere: content-spec.md "## Unit 5" lists only SLO:EFMP-302-5-1, whose parenthetical "(challenges/realities of the profession, digital-age professionalism)" covers both scopes under one ID. Every other unit's spec section defines both of the SLO IDs its files use (2-1/2-2, 3-1/3-2, 4-1/4-2, 6-1/6-2). No gate validates clo_refs against the spec and no learner-facing text renders the ID, so this is a traceability-metadata gap, not a coverage gap: the outcome scope itself is recorded under 5-1. Repair: add the 5-2 definition (digital-age professionalism and responding to challenges, tracing to the same guide CLOs 3 and 4) to the spec's Unit 5 CLO/SLO refs, or collapse the unit's clo_refs to the defined 5-1.
